scope: Appearance of the Sculpted base on the bed and in hand, including the underside after support release.
observations: Also, we ended up with a pretty gnarly seam on the front side there, and I've got two questions about that. What the hell is it doing on the front side, and why is it so gnarly? Or rather, I don't really want those questions answered. I just want it fixed. Thanks.

So on the faucet, the base support broke off beautifully. Like, that turned out really, really well at the bottom there, you can see in the photos, that it just all broke off as, like, one clean piece, and it took a little bit of force, but that was great. Loved that. And the back of the faucet base, the seam that's back there where it normally is, that looks normal. It's fine. But then we've got this second seam in front that I don't understand how we ended up with that. I mean, we don't need two seams, right? And it's also all fuzzy and ugly. Like, there's something weird going on there. And I see some fuzziness other places too, and so, like, I'm worried it's just something about the technique we're using here that is doing something unusual, but I hope that's fixed in your next plate here. Please tell me if it is.

Like, the problem is wobbling. If it does the normal thing like it does in that picture I just sent of what we had on the faucet base, where it branches to something thinner at the very tips, that seems to work fine. But look at the size of the trunk there. We actually have a trunk. It's these places where it has absolutely no trunk, and it's just a bunch of tiny little towers, or even worse, one or two tiny little towers. That's the thing that we need to never have. Do you get me?
